svg.title: Cyberpunk Themes for Claude Code
svg.desc: A short looping film: a title card, then each of the eight themes (Neon Rooftop, Phosphor Alley, Deep Net, Ripperdoc, Badlands, Blackwall, Neon 2099, Corpo Plaza) behind an example conversation, then all eight side by side.

g.text: Can you fix the flaky login test?
Found it: a race on the session cookie.
Patched, then re-ran it 50 times. All green.
Clean up the payment retry logic.
Retries now go through one backoff helper.
Three call sites share it; tests updated.
Why is the orders API slow?
An N+1 query in /orders. One join brings
p95 from 840 ms down to 90 ms.
SELECT * FROM orders JOIN items USING (order_id)
Add validation to the checkout form.
Every field now goes through one schema.
14 new tests cover the edge cases.
Draft the release notes for v2.4.
grouped by area, breaking changes first.
One finding: tokens were never checked
for expiry. Fixed, with a regression test.
Searches go through a 60-second cache now.
Repeat queries dropped from 310 ms to 4 ms.
Contrast and focus order fixed, and every
chart now has a text summary.
for Claude Code. Eight pixel worlds behind your chat.
